subject: To capture the name of the data set selected by the user?

messages.author: b66f7d1e154bde4b
messages.subject: To capture the name of the data set selected by the user?
parts:
Hi,
 
Thanks in advance.
 
I am using R-3.0.1 on Windows XP.
 
May I request you for the following please.
 

I am trying to use googleVis with shiny.

I am using the example given in the section 3.4.4 of "Using the Google Chart Tools with R: googleVis-0.4.3 Package Vignette" document. The code is below.

It is working fine.

In this example, user can select the data set to be displayed.

I like to give a title for the chart.

In server.R:

gvisScatterChart(datasetInput(), options= list(title= ???))

The question is:

- How can I capture the name of the data set selected by the user?

x <- ???

I like to capture the name of the data set in x.

I like to give a good title of the graph using x. example: titleName = paste(x, ": Test only"). This is the title, I like to give.

Once again, thank you very much for the time you have given.

Regards,

Deb

 

# server.R

library(shiny)

library(googleVis)

shinyServer(function(input, output) {

datasetInput <- reactive({

switch(input$dataset,

"rock" = rock,

"pressure" = pressure,

"cars" = cars)

})

x <- datasetInput

print(x)

output$view <- renderGvis({

gvisScatterChart(datasetInput())

})

})

 

# ui.R

library(shiny)

library(googleVis)

shinyUI(pageWithSidebar(

headerPanel("googleVis on Shiny"),

sidebarPanel(

selectInput("dataset", "Choose a dataset:",

choices = c("rock", "pressure", "cars"))

),

mainPanel(

htmlOutput("view")

)

))
